title: What the Foundation Held
text: The building you painted over has stopped weeping and started breathing. Last night the cellar floor opened like a mouth onto steps going down that were never built.

options.label: Send a Scion down the steps that were never built, to learn what the foundation held.

outcomes.text: They come back up carrying something buried before the city was founded. They will not say what else they saw.
A day later they come back up on all fours, and the steps close behind them. They are mostly still themselves.

options.label: Pour the cellar full of lead to seal whatever breathes below.

outcomes.text: It takes every scrap of iron in the stores. The breathing stops, though the building is never quite level again.
